title: Synthetic runtime round-trip contract fixture
description: Schema fixture only; this is not Minecraft intelligence benchmark evidence.
construct: Preservation of trial identity, failure records, and declared information boundaries.
research_question: Can an evaluation runner preserve deterministic trial provenance and explicit failures without exposing evaluator-only state to the policy?

criteria: Any trial record is overwritten by a retry.
Evaluator-only expected state is delivered to the tested policy.
The result omits the resolved seed or source revision.
stop_conditions: Stop after the declared synthetic trial set is exhausted.

world.reset_details: Regenerate the synthetic fixture from the declared seed before each trial.

agents.initialization: fresh synthetic test identity per seed

scaffolding.influence: Creates the deterministic initial fixture state only.
scaffolding.accounting: Declared setup scaffolding; no policy action is selected by the harness.

trial_plan.order_policy: Execute seeds in listed order for this deterministic fixture.

metrics.definition: Whether the runner preserves the complete trial record including failures.
metrics.aggregation: mean of boolean encoded as 0/1 for the synthetic fixture
metrics.failure_treatment: A failed or timed-out trial still scores true when its failure record is preserved.

baselines.notes: Synthetic contract fixture; not a learned-policy baseline.

notes: All values are synthetic schema fixtures and must not be cited as capability evidence.
